notes.title: Hotfix, edge collision
notes.content: Hotfix for paddle overlapping level edge resulting in paddle being unable to move.

notes.title: Hot fix
notes.content: Hot fix to correct bug with entering high scores that allowed scores to be entered more than once.

notes.title: High Scores now saved per map set.
notes.content: High Scores are now recorded individually for each map set. Unfortunately, this also means all high scores have been reset.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42595462/e840ce71ee12c9c4a74b1d0c290a0a578e78bb74.png[/img]

notes.title: Level Editor UI overhauled
notes.content:
The level editor UI was made more useful and easier to use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42595462/0f551d94e7011a6e6f28ae1bf38c6bd70749e5f9.png[/img]

notes.title: Minor Update to UI and controls
notes.content:
Some minor update.
[list]
[*]Adjustments to timing of end game UI elements.
[*]Space-bar added to primary attack. W added to secondary attack.
[*]Minor changes to high score display. High score switched to mono spaced font.
[*]Slight adjustments to placement of bricks in game levels and level editor to correct brick alignement.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fix to level editor.
notes.content: Bug fix for level editor not creating custom map directory.

notes.title: Update to level editor
notes.content: Level editor is mostly functional now. It's not pretty, but it's working. I'll clean it up soon.

notes.title: Minor Update - Level editor packaged in current build
notes.content:
Added transition effect when new levels are created.

Added a very early and rough version of the level editor that will be packaged with the final game.

Some other minor changes.
